description: This Java source file defines the `BatchHelper` utility class in the `org.apache.fineract.integrationtests.common` package. It provides methods to create and manipulate batch requests and responses for integration testing of the Apache Fineract platform. The class includes methods for generating various types of batch requests (e.g., creating clients, loans, charges, transactions, datatable entries), posting these requests to the server, and verifying client existence. The content indicates that this file supports testing and automation of complex batch operations in Fineract's API.
